claim: Descriptive measurements from one already-finished SDK 1.2 standalone-host run; no speedup or performance-budget conclusion

host.description: Same corrected host source (CodeMode caller overlay f9495350672382574ee8f1e8b3e4c8e46ceb9ef3dd521b28cf2ffbeed900004f) with reference/original-parent versus candidate/adjusted-location managed loaders; identical histories and strict reference-first, candidate-second pairs.

statistics.digits: Values below rounded to 3 decimal ms; exact precision retained in source raw JSON

coldMetricsMs.interpretation: Single observation per side; no cold significance or stable comparison claim. Cold means new process/session, not flushed OS page cache.

measurementBoundary.wire: First incremental assistant text observed in shared-wire agent_events/message_start before tail release.
measurementBoundary.terminal: First incremental text bytes observed by native-renderer PTY before tail release; not parsed terminal paint, browser paint, or proof of text being visible to a person.
measurementBoundary.submitAndFixtureSeparation: submitToFixtureRequestMs ends when local HTTP fixture receives request; fixtureTraceDurationMs runs from fixture receipt through tail/completion; fixtureFirstChunkToWireMs and fixtureFirstChunkToTerminalMs start at first fixture SSE chunk flush. Do not add these as independent measures or label first chunk as submit latency.
measurementBoundary.workload: Local two-chunk SSE faux response, ALPHA held until wire and PTY incremental bytes observed, then OMEGA/tail release. No external model inference/network.

validityAndVerdict.workOccurred: All 62 measured rows recorded pre-tail text observation; 30/30 warm reference-candidate request message hashes match per index. Candidate index 31 is an extra held functional diagnostic, excluded from timed data.
validityAndVerdict.errors: Run raw errors array is empty; receipt records 11/11 standalone host scenarios exit 0 and expected deny probes. This is not proof of zero errors outside observed boundaries.
validityAndVerdict.limiter: NOT IDENTIFIED: no independent limiter profile/counter trace; run-level load averages and CPU count do not attribute the bottleneck.
validityAndVerdict.verdict: INCONCLUSIVE for candidate-vs-reference performance; descriptive baseline observations only.
limitations: Reference always first; no AB/BA counterbalancing, so order/drift confounded.
Same host implementation on both sides; loader paths differ. This is not an implementation optimization comparison or SDK migration claim.
PTY bytes are not browser paint or user-visible-text proof.
No speedup, performance-budget PASS, or meaningful winner claim.
BB0 baseline is not a current-optimization claim; the plan's 15% p95 rule applies to subsequent slices, not this baseline run.
No ratio for absent native-BB-child capability; mark that path N/A, not a synthetic zero or fake speedup.

reproduction.method: Pure Python 3 standard-library transformation of the immutable source JSON; no benchmark, model, network, or host process was run for this report.
reproduction.code: import json, math, statistics; d=json.load(open(SOURCE)); rows=d['samples']; for phase in ('warm',): for side in ('reference','candidate'): for metric in METRICS: v=[r[metric] for r in rows if r['phase']==phase and r['side']==side]; median=statistics.median(v); p95=sorted(v)[math.ceil(.95*len(v))-1]; range=(min(v),max(v))
